EBMLElement represents an EBML element with its ID, size, and data.
An EBML element is the basic building block of EBML files. Each element consists of:
- ID: A variable-length integer that identifies the type of element
- Size: A variable-length integer that specifies the size of the element's data
- Data: The actual data contained within the element
The EBMLElement struct provides methods to extract different types of data from the element,
such as integers, floats, strings, and raw bytes.

name: Demuxer
comments: Demuxer is a Matroska demuxer using pure Go implementation.
The Demuxer struct provides the main interface for parsing and reading Matroska files.
It encapsulates the underlying parser and provides methods for accessing track information,
file metadata, and reading media packets. The Demuxer can work with both seekable and
non-seekable input streams.
For seekable inputs, use NewDemuxer. For non-seekable streams (like network streams),
use NewStreamingDemuxer.

name: MatroskaParser
comments: MatroskaParser represents a parser for Matroska and WebM files.
It provides functionality to parse Matroska container files, extract metadata,
and read media packets. The parser maintains state information about the file
structure, including the EBML header, segment information, tracks, and other
metadata elements.
The parser can operate in two modes:
- With seeking enabled (noSeeking=false): Allows for more efficient parsing
by seeking to specific positions in the file when needed.
- With seeking disabled (noSeeking=true): Parses the file sequentially,
which is useful for streaming or non-seekable input sources.
After creating a parser with NewMatroskaParser, you can access file information,
track information, and read media packets using the provided methods.

name: SegmentElement
comments: SegmentElement represents the main segment element in a Matroska file.
The segment is the top-level element in a Matroska file that contains all
the actual data, including metadata, tracks, clusters, and other elements.
It is the largest element in the file and contains all other elements except
for the EBML header.
The Position field indicates the byte offset from the beginning of the file
where the segment element starts, and the Size field indicates the total size
of the segment element in bytes.

name: Packet
comments: Packet contains a demuxed packet from a Matroska file.
A Packet represents a single unit of media data that has been extracted (demuxed) from
a Matroska container. It contains all the necessary information to process the media data,
including timing information, track association, and the actual data payload.

name: Chapter

name: Cue

A Cue structure contains the timing and position information needed to locate

name: Target

name: Tag

like titles, descriptions, and other information about the content.

fields.name: warmingActive

name: TrackType

fields.name: Type

name: Info

name: ContentEncodings

name: ContentEncoding
comments: ContentEncoding describes a single encoding applied to the track data

comments: ContentCompression describes how the track data is compressed

name: ChapterAtom
comments: ChapterAtom represents a single chapter point

name: ChapterDisplay
comments: ChapterDisplay contains displayable chapter information

name: AttachedFile

name: Block
comments: Block represents a data block in the MKV file

name: BlockGroup
comments: BlockGroup represents a group of blocks with additional information

name: Cluster
comments: Cluster represents a cluster of blocks in the MKV file

name: Tracks
comments: Tracks element and its children

name: PgsDecoder

fields.name: objects
comments: Store completed objects by ID
PgsDecoder decodes PGS packets into images

fields.name: PTS
comments: Presentation timestamp

fields.name: DTS
comments: Decode timestamp

name: OfflinePlatform
comments: OfflinePlatform used when offline.

name: DynamicPlatform

fields.name: current
comments: platformWrapper
DynamicPlatform implementa Platform y redirige atómicamente entre una
plataforma online y una offline. Reemplaza el uso de *util.Ref[Platform].

name: MediaKind
comments: MediaKind distinguishes the content category independently of MediaType.
Anime = Japanese animation (AniList-sourced or manually flagged)
General = western series, movies, documentaries, etc.

fields.name: Kind
comments: "ANIME" or "GENERAL"

name: MatchWindow
comments: MatchWindow describe el segmento de audio común hallado entre dos fingerprints.
Start/End están en segundos relativos al inicio de cada fingerprint (no al
archivo). Score es la densidad media de items matcheados dentro de la ventana
[0..1], útil para rankear varios candidatos (p. ej. OP1 vs OP2).

name: Detector

fields.name: batchRunning
comments: scan de biblioteca completa en curso (uno a la vez)

fields.name: attempted
comments: trigger oportunista: máx. una vez por media por run

fields.name: athClient
comments: Método A (puede ser nil → cae a Método B)

fields.name: fileCacher
comments: Método C: extracción on-demand de subs (puede ser nil)
Detector orquesta la cadena de detección de intros/outros para una serie.

name: CachedFingerprint
comments: CachedFingerprint representa el payload persistido en disco de una huella de audio.

name: SubHint
comments: SubHint son pistas de intro/outro extraídas de los subtítulos ASS de un
episodio: ventanas directas (bloques de karaoke con estilo OP/ED) y un hueco
de diálogo largo que suele coincidir con la OP. Cada ventana es [start, end]
en segundos, o nil si no se detectó.

name: Theme

fields.name: Type
comments: "OP" | "ED"

fields.name: AudioURL
comments: link al audio (.ogg) del theme
Theme es un opening/ending oficial de una serie según AnimeThemes.moe. Vive en
este paquete (no en api/animethemes) para que el cliente concreto lo produzca
sin que skipdetect dependa del paquete HTTP: skipdetect define el contrato,
api/animethemes lo implementa.

name: ThumbnailCache
comments: ThumbnailCache provides a concurrent-safe, memory-bounded LRU cache
dedicated to avoiding disk I/O when serving grid images/thumbnails.

name: Manager
comments: Manager coordinates status checking and downloading of FFmpeg/FFprobe binaries.

name: FFmpegStatus

fields.name: DownloadProgress
comments: 0-100 percentage

fields.name: DownloadStatus
comments: Status message, e.g. "Downloading FFprobe..."
FFmpegStatus represents the runtime status of FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries.

name: CacheStore
comments: CacheStore represents a single-process, file-based, key/value cache store.

name: Bucket
comments: Bucket represents a cache bucket with a name and TTL.

name: Cacher
comments: Cacher represents a single-process, file-based, key/value cache.

fields.name: Endpoint
comments: The endpoint this token is valid for

name: Reader

fields.name: order
comments: orden de carga, para desalojar el bloque más viejo
Reader implementa io.ReadSeeker sobre una URL que soporta Range. Lee en
bloques de tamaño fijo y conserva los últimos bloques en memoria, así los
saltos cortos del parser (volver a una cabecera, releer un elemento) no
generan una petición nueva. No es seguro para uso concurrente.

name: RWMutexMap
comments: RWMutexMap is an implementation of mapInterface using a sync.RWMutex.

name: BoundedCache
comments: BoundedCache implements an LRU cache with a maximum capacity

name: InSight
comments: InSight represents the video insight service (formerly character scanning, now simplified).

name: PlaybackType
comments: PlaybackType is the playback method.

fields.name: Type
comments: "srt" | "vtt" | "ass" | "ssa"
VideoSubtitleTrack is an external subtitle track.

fields.name: Type

name: VideoSource

name: VideoInitialState
comments: VideoInitialState specifies the initial state for the player.

name: VideoPlaybackInfo

fields.name: StreamPath

fields.name: MkvMetadata
comments: NativePlayer only
VideoPlaybackInfo contains detailed information about the currently played media.
It is filled by the client, passed to the player and sent to the server during playback.
